configurations.name: npo-polet-prod
runtimeArgs: PAYLOAD_SECRET="$(awk -F= '/^PAYLOAD_SECRET/{print $2}' .env)" DATABASE_URI="$(awk -F= '/^DATABASE_URI=/{sub(/^DATABASE_URI=/,"");print}' .env)" EMAIL_ENABLED=false REDIS_HOST=localhost npx next start -p 3001

configurations.name: npo-polet-dev-yandex
runtimeArgs: YANDEX_CLIENT_ID=mock-client YANDEX_CLIENT_SECRET=mock-secret YANDEX_OAUTH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4610 YANDEX_LOGIN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4610 npx next dev -p 3000
